news.title: New major risk - Revenue and earnings growth
news.body: Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 10% per year for the foreseeable future. This is considered a major risk. Ultimately, shareholders want to see a good return on their investment and that generally comes from sharing in the company's profits. If profits are expected to decline, then in most cases the share price will decline over time as well. In addition, if the company pays dividends it will also likely need to reduce or cut them, striking a dual blow to total shareholder returns. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Earnings are forecast to decline by an average of 10% per year for the foreseeable future. Minor Risk Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (9.0% average weekly change).

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹6.03 (up from ₹1.14 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹15.3b (up 21% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹1.89b (up ₹2.24b from FY 2025). Profit margin: 12% (up from net loss in FY 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Revenue missed analyst estimates by 8.0%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 107%. Revenue is forecast to grow 18% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 13% growth forecast for the Consumer Durables industry in India.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 8.7% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. This is currently the only risk that has been identified for the company.
